outcome: termal mailbox read --json fails with 'missing field body' whenever the page holds the reader's own send
acceptance: `termal mailbox read` succeeds, in --json and text forms, on a page that holds the reader's own send. The own message keeps `bodyOmitted: true` without a body, and the text form says the body is omitted and how to read it. A CLI test covers both forms and fails before the fix.
A read page whose message carries both `body` and `bodyOmitted`, or a non-true `bodyOmitted`, is still rejected as unusable; a test covers it.
The full five-stage gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
